name: Festival Stone of Gloaming
title: Festival Stone of Gloaming
summary: The Festival Stone of Gloaming is one of the Empyrean festival stones in the heart of the Direlands (Alatar Locke). It stands on the pine-covered west flank (z 380) of the Floating Spire hill, with its Anniversary Effect glow 8 m above it and a Giant Snowman NPC 62 m east. The stone and its glow are ACE spawns. Its landblock 0x277A has terrain, trees and spawns in the kit but no WBT statics.
